problem: A particle $P$ moves along the $x$-axis in the direction of decreasing $x$ where $x>0.$ When the displacement of $P$ from $O$ is $x\,m,$ its velocity is $v\,m/s,$ the magnitude of its acceleration is $\frac{2}{{x}^{2}+1}\,{m/s}^{2}$ and the acceleration is directed toward $O.$ If $v=-\sqrt{\pi }\,m/s$ when $x=1\,\text{m},$ find the velocity of $P$ when $x=3\,\text{m}.$ Round your answer to one decimal place.

activity_context.topic_title: Velocity and Acceleration as Functions of Displacement
